review: Reviewed the actual Lin failures/request and accepted world-33 specification at tick 15. The new coordinate-specific non-destructive surface examination costs one round and 0.5 energy, requires one round of personal learning, and reuses an extracted read-only planting predicate without changing its original order or error strings. The old bare-ground restriction is retained as an implementation limit, distinguished from the ordinary-soil moisture regime and from universal biological suitability. Observed surface and visible overlaps are separate from unknown hidden occupants, deeper substrate and future conditions. Private dated records do not reserve, transform or guarantee a site. There are no material, inventory, ownership, terrain, reward or mastery grants. The atomic single-round work has no escrow or resumable unfinished completion; later attempts pay again. Generic action movement and a neutral event-bound footprint outline show only actual examination. Targeted regressions reproduce the recorded forest-floor coordinates and real bare-patch geometry, require learning/payment, reject inaccessible invocations without charges, preserve material/terrain and keep records personal. This diagnostic will be separated from productive capability gains. Adapter full checks and exact prior-prefix reconstruction remain required.
